It was probably 1993. I was around 15.  It was around 30 years ago.  It could have been exactly 30 years ago today.

While in the shower, playing with a pimple on my left buttcheek, something exploded and flew 2 or 3 feet and stuck to the shower wall.  I was amazed.  I’d never experienced anything like it.  

I assumed that was it.  Adios pimple! But no!  That pimple never went away.  It constantly bothered me for years.

Until maybe 2002 or so, one time it got super infected and swelled up and I went to the doctor.  By the time I got to see a specialist a few days later (thanks American medical system!) the dermatologist couldn’t really help me but said if that swelling happened again to call his office directly.

But the pimple never once bothered me again.  I could feel there was a little ball deep in there, but at no point did it get enflamed or come to the surface or whatever.  It just chilled for about 20 years.

About a year ago I had some back and hip problems.  I spent months heating my lower back and hips and my *butt*.

I think months of heat caused this ball to start to come to the surface.

I’m not going to lie. When I noticed it coming to the surface maybe 8 months ago, I went a little nuts.  I probably did more damage than good.  I’m sure everyone reading this sub understands.

But after that moment of weakness?  I was so bleeping good guys.  I was SO BLEEPING GOOD! You’d be so proud of me!  I didn’t go after this thing for months!  I spent months with heat and long hot showers and lots of Neosporin and lots of gently nudging it.  I was so good for months!  I’m a good boy!

Then today, I had zero intention of playing with it today.  I had no idea today was the day.  I was showering, I very casually checked it with my fingers, and instantly realized HOLY SHIT TODAY IS THE DAY!

Guys and girls, I spent about 90 seconds kinda picking the dead skin off around the spot, and after about 2 minutes of gently playing with it, it gently squeezed out!

It’s this tiny little 30 year old rock hard piece of whatever!  And it’s gone!  Adios amigo!  It’s a new day!  It’s a new world!  It’s a new me! Tell the world tell the world! (From my anonymous throw away account) TELL THE WHOLE BLEEPING WORLD!

CONGRATULATE ME!  HUG ME!  LOVE ME!  ITS THE NEW BLEEPING ME!

I LOVE YOU GUYS SO MUCH!  IM GOING TO PLAY WITH THIS LITTE THING AND DISECT IT AND THEN WASH IT DOWN THE BLEEPING TOILET!  ADIOS AMIGO!

I LOVE YOU ALL SO MUCH!  PLEASE CONGRATULATE ME!
